dict.title: Eklentiler
dict.intro: Configure and inspect the eklentis installed in this deployment.
dict.empty: This deployment exposes no eklenti ayarlar.
dict.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
dict.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the varsayılan.
dict.bashDescription: Limits every komut the agent runs.
dict.bashTimeoutMsHint: How long one komut may run before it is terminated.
dict.bashMaxOutputBytesHint: Output beyond this spills to a temporary dosya rather than being lost.
dict.agentLoopDescription: How the agent dispatches araç calls.
dict.agentLoopMaxParallelHint: Upper bound on parallel-safe calls running at once within one step.
dict.webSearchApiKeyHint: Stored outside the ayarlar dosya. Leave blank to keep the mevcut key.
dict.webSearchApiKeyUnset: Hiç key is configured; search is unkullanılabilir until one is.
dict.webSearchBaseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the provider varsayılan.
dict.webSearchMaxUsesHint: How many times one request may search before it must answer.
